content.text:
I fixed the commitlint failure on the commit message and force-pushed the corrected commit. The code is unchanged.

**Cause:** commitlint's `body-max-line-length` rule allows at most 100 characters per line in the commit body. The body of `76e807a` was all on one line, much longer than that.

**Fix:** I amended the commit message (now `74976de`). The header and wording are the same. I only broke the body into lines under 100 characters and moved `Refs #46` to its own line. The tree is the same as before (`git diff 76e807a 74976de` is empty).

The same commitlint command the workflow uses now passes locally on `af1a09f..HEAD`. The PR checks should go green when they run on the new head.
